sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Nekoosa is a premier manufacturer of specialty print media with a 60-year legacy of innovation spanning coating, converting and custom plastic extrusion capabilities.

Industry: Manufacturing · HQ: Nekoosa, Wisconsin · Size: <$50M · Products: NextBond®, Dye Sublimation Transfer Paper, Nekoosa Promise®, Wide Format Media, Trifecta®, SYNAPS OM

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Nekoosa scores 46 of 100 (tier C) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (16/30), application fit (16/25) and pain-point alignment (10/15). Nothing was found for event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on weatherability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (44% similar on films, media, specialty, print); Drytac (44% similar on films, media, print, graphic); ORAFOL Europe (30% similar on films, graphic, digital, printing). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.
